title: Record one positive-quarter degree-5 n=8 parity prefix at 25/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Records one n=8 parity prefix for `(1, 1/4, -1/16, -1/16, -1/16, -1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`, the degree-5 sign left open by #4887. The tail `l1` is `5/8`. The largest proper-prefix infinity norm is `25/16`, strictly above `3/2`. The first proper prefix is `1379/1024`, below `11/8`. The next four are `11/8`, the next five are `23/16`, and eleven proper prefixes equal `25/16`. The even child stays `(1, -1/16, -1/16, 1/16)`. The opening shear carries `-51/1024`. The Schur left shear changes to the pair `-1/8`, `341/4096` and does not raise a running norm already at `25/16`. The completed product matches the reordered Toeplitz matrix and has infinity norm `13/8`.

No new κ. The selected record stays `60403/20000000`. Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. This branch starts at fetched main and does not stack on an unmerged predecessor. It does not enumerate the 128-symbol sign family, spend `p^100`, or change the selected frontier.

## Test plan

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-positive-quarter-degree-five-sign
```

That replay passed locally and printed `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_POSITIVE_QUARTER_DEGREE_FIVE_SIGN`.
